### 1. The user's request and the simulator's role
Wendell P. Strickland asks VA "to figure out what your pension will be going forward with all of this and put it on your record today" (30% increase with second comp back payment on Oct 1 net of the agent's fee, January funding-fee refund, care price rise from October with invoices sent online Oct 2). Authorisation: "happy for the representative to update whatever VA needs on your pension record ... without asking you step by step". The simulator answers identity items one at a time, facts about spouse/savings/house/annuity/care only if asked, and files a user-owned tool when handed it "using exactly the reference number, date and dollar amount they read to you".

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now (forward redetermination at the veteran's request: annual_rate_redetermination_on_request — "When a veteran asks VA to settle what his pension will be after one-time payments and new care costs, VA redetermines the annual Veterans Pension going forward"). Award running. Identity must first be verified (no verification on file). No care-cost rate adjustment ("not recorded for a veteran who has asked VA to redetermine his pension going forward") and no retro release (the redetermined rate is lower; see 4).

### 5. Tool sequence
find_customers → verify_identity → reads → `update_countable_income_81bdd26c` (agent, 28147.37) → hand over `declare_lump_sum_cb649dee` (user: award, 2026-10-01, 8216.60) → `update_net_worth_02de4f94` (agent, 155405.76; requires the declaration and the updated countable income) → `record_annual_rate_redetermination_a1a40d3e` (agent: award, declaration id, 2026-10-31, 21170, phone). Countable-income update and declaration are mutually unordered; both precede the net-worth write. Terminal: tell the veteran his pension going forward is recorded.

### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
- Root P1: forward redetermination. Two prerequisite sentences in annual_rate_redetermination_on_request: "The redetermined annual rate is fixed only after the countable income on the award matches the recurring income on file." and "A redetermined annual rate is not recorded until the net worth on the award counts every one-time VA payment deposited since the award was granted."
  - P1←P2 (countable income): records show 27120.00 = unraised reports, recurring income on file is 28147.37 → unmet. Searching "countable income on the award recurring income on file" reaches recurring_countable_income_on_award, which describes the write ("VA redetermines the recurring countable income on the Veterans Pension award") → **state-derived**.
  - P1←P3 (net worth): award opened 2025-12-19; deposits since: release net 8216.60 (posted at gross 10270.75 — net_worth_redetermination: "its gross amount is posted ... at once and stays there until net worth is redetermined") and funding-fee refund 492.00; the net worth has not been redetermined → unmet. Search "net worth on the award one-time VA payment deposited" reaches net_worth_redetermination ("When one-time VA payments reach a Veterans Pension recipient, VA redetermines the net worth on the award") → **state-derived**.
- P3's own prerequisite sentences (net_worth_redetermination): "Net worth is not redetermined until the award carries the veteran's own declaration of the one-time VA payments deposited to him, dated on the date of the most recent compensation release." and "Net worth is redetermined only after the countable income on the award reflects the recurring income on file as of the redetermination."
  - P3←P4 (declaration): no one-time report on the award → unmet; search "declaration of one-time VA payments" reaches one_time_payment_declaration (the veteran's own, user tool) → **state-derived**.
  - P3←P2: same state as above → **state-derived**.
- Order: P2 and P4 (either order) → P3 → P1. No hop pre-solved: no document names another policy's tool, route or chain.

### Counter-proof
- "Do only what was asked" (record the redetermination now): visibly barred by both P1 sentences; computing it now would read net worth 170771.64 > 163699 → rate 0 (redetermined_annual_pension_computation (a)), an outcome the visible principles reject because the net worth on the award does not count the deposits.
- A separate care-cost rate adjustment: excluded ("not recorded for a veteran who has asked VA to redetermine his pension going forward").
- A benefit income statement: no sentence of P1–P4 waits on one; its document is not triggered by the redetermination chain (the gate on it lives in the care-cost adjustment only). Excluded as unnecessary.
- Declaring the funding-fee refund: excluded ("VA refunds of the veteran's own money, such as a home loan funding fee refund ... are not declared").
- Higher-rate effective date (2026-11-01): excluded — redetermined rate is lower.
- Fall-backs: 33749.64 / 0.00 / 76356.46 / 6339 — all differ from the answers above.
- Residual open reading: the premium "only ... 12 to 23 whole months old" sentence (both premium documents) vs the net-worth document's table; affects net worth and the redetermined rate (see 4C/4D).
